entries.behavior_changes: Preserve bounded ordered bootstrap buffering, ACK-gated chunked writes, deadlines, close semantics, and synchronous bootstrap payload tagging. Comments are updated for the TLS-like dataplane; no DTLS runtime dependency is carried forward.
entries.tests: internal/faketcp/bootstrap_stream_test.go covers reordering, per-chunk ACK gating, deadlines, chunk/byte bounds, uint32 sequence wrap, marker scope, and close/EOF.

entries.behavior_changes: Extract wrap-aware seqLT/seqLE only. No Receiver, SACK/RACK, repair pressure, or steady-state delivery policy is migrated here.
entries.tests: bootstrap and transition tests exercise comparisons across uint32 wrap.

entries.behavior_changes: Extract only copied Pending payload ownership, cumulative ACK release, ACK waiting, oldest-payload RTO retransmit, bootstrap 2s retransmit ceiling, and the invariant that bootstrap retries do not back off the shared RTO. The archived bootstrap_retransmit_test.go was also inspected as behavioral evidence, but the ledger source field remains the single code source path required by repository contract. Steady-state SACK/RACK/repair-budget/partial-reliability logic is intentionally not migrated in this task.
entries.tests: internal/faketcp/bootstrap_sender_test.go covers the archived bootstrap ceiling invariant, later ordinary RTO backoff, cumulative ACK wait/deadline, retransmit Seq/payload identity, and uint32 wrap.

note: P2 now has the temporary bootstrap stream plus the minimum sender behavior required to ACK-gate it. internal/faketcp/transition.go is new code implementing DEVELOPMENT_PLAN section 3 ownership boundaries; it is not copied from old. The archive remains read-only and steady-state ARQ/FEC remain deferred.
